{{Quote|The slicer's name is Zalia. Force her to input the virus into the system, then eliminate her. No loose ends.|[[Lieutenant Major]] [[Pirrell]], to the [[Hunter (individual)|Hunter]]|<ref name="TOR:CatDF" />}}
'''Zalia''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]] data [[Slicer/Legends|slicer]] who was active during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|The security team escorting the slicer was killed by the facility's droids. Now, the slicer is trapped inside. The slicer refuses to input the virus until I send a rescue team.|[[Lieutenant Major]] [[Pirrell]]|<ref name="TOR:CatDF" />}}
When the Empire [[Battle of Balmorra (Galactic Wars)|invaded]] [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]], the Imperials began to sabotage the [[Okara Droid Factory]] which turned the droids inside the facility into crazed killing machines.<ref name="TOR:CatDF" /> In [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR_dates" /> Imperial [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Sartius]] was very close to deciphering the facility's control codes, opening the possibility to bring the droids fully under the Empire's control. To ruin Sartius' efforts, Zalia was tasked by rival [[Lieutenant Major]] [[Pirrell]] to enter a code-scrambling virus into the facility's computer system. When she went inside the facility with a security team, they were ambushed and the entire team was killed, leaving Zalia the only to survive and hid for nearly few days.<ref name="TOR:CatDF" />
{{GameDS}}
As Zalia refused to continue the mission until a rescue team was sent, Major Pirrell tasked a [[Hunter (individual)|bounty hunter]] to enter the facility, force her to input the virus into the system and then kill her. As the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] arrived to the facility, Zalia was forced to do input the virus, in which she did, but she did not realize that she would die for not following orders by Pirrell. She begged the hunter to spare her since she wanted to see her family, but the hunter refused her offer and shot the slicer.<ref name="TOR:CatDF" />
{{Endgame}}
